antithesis: I believe that exposing hepatocytes to 870nm light at 345 THz could repair mitochondrial damage in Complex IV
synthesis: But prolonged exposure at 870nm might generate too much heat and damage surrounding tissue in hepatocytes
conclusion: So the best approach is to apply dual-phase Hsp70 activation at 220 THz followed by main pulse at 370 THz with 30% reduced amplitude for 10 minutes targeting Complex IV in hepatocytes based on the 2025 findings about neuroprotection confirmed
